svg.title: The Monstrous Sea: nineteen original vector engravings

g.text: Native SVG paths · 200 × 200 vessels & beasts · 64 × 64 equipment · Iron-gall ink on vellum

svg.title: Ironclad Ram
svg.desc: Low armored ram ship. A bolted mast meets the deck at (112, 124); riveted plates, a reinforced pilot house and a submerged prow are engraved in iron-gall ink.

svg.title: Heavy Freighter
svg.desc: Three square-rigged masts meet the two-deck cargo hull at (53,124), (101,124), and (147,108). A high sterncastle, deep draft and cargo hatches identify the freighter.

svg.title: Swift Corvette
svg.desc: Fine raked clipper bow and two lateen rigs with booms and sheets. Masts are rooted on the deck at (74,128) and (132,128); the bowsprit joins the bow at (32,128).

svg.title: Standard Sloop
svg.desc: Balanced two-masted merchant schooner with gaff sails, a square topsail and a jib. Both masts terminate on the deck at (70,128) and (125,128).

svg.title: Flying Dutchman
svg.desc: Haunted galleon with three rooted masts at (53,126), (104,126), and (151,112). Torn canvas, exposed barnacle ribs, broken stern galleries and thin spectral wakes evoke an antique sea legend.

svg.title: Cartographer's Shark
svg.desc: A muscular predatory shark in profile, engraved with gill cuts, a serrated jaw, hatched flanks and curling sea foam.

svg.title: Leviathan Serpent
svg.desc: A horned sea serpent rises in connected coils. Overlapping engraved scales, dorsal spines and a toothed crimson mouth recall sea-chart marginalia.

svg.title: Stinging Medusa
svg.desc: An engraved domed bell with scalloped margins and connected venomous tendrils. Stippled cells and sinuous oral arms preserve a transparent vellum silhouette.

svg.title: Abyssal Squid
svg.desc: A tapered squid mantle with paired fins and eight attached curling arms. Engraved suckers, mantle hatching and watchful eyes suggest an abyssal chart specimen.

svg.title: Armored Crustacean
svg.desc: A carapaced sea crab with articulated limbs, two enormous toothed pincers, stalked eyes and a cross-hatched segmented shell.

svg.title: Colossal Kraken
svg.desc: A crowned abyssal kraken with eight connected curling tentacles, double rows of engraved suckers and a crimson beak. Its massive domed mantle towers over the chart's sea lines.

svg.title: Unstable Tincture
svg.desc: Corked apothecary bottle containing bubbling venom, with a droplet seal and engraved glass reflections.

svg.title: Blast Pack
svg.desc: Wooden gunpowder keg bound with iron hoops and crossed cord. A burning fuse sparks above the bung.

svg.title: Chakram
svg.desc: Sixteen serrated teeth surround an open throwing ring. Radial engraving and crossed edge hatching define its sharpened bevel.

svg.title: Broadside Cannon
svg.desc: Cast broadside gun on a wheeled oak carriage, with reinforced barrel rings, breech knob, trunnion and touch hole.

svg.title: Torpedo Launcher
svg.desc: Riveted twin launch tubes in an oak deck cradle, with a pointed brass torpedo, tail fins and handwheel.

svg.title: Blade Launcher
svg.desc: Deck-mounted rotary blade launcher. An open circular saw sits in a braced wooden track driven by a brass crank.

svg.title: Lightning Railgun
svg.desc: Nautical brass and iron railgun with paired rails, induction coils, Leyden jar and a crimson lightning discharge.

svg.title: Flamethrower
svg.desc: A copper pressure reservoir feeds an iron fire projector through a curved hose. A wick flame and brass valve distinguish the deck weapon.
